name: Poss'Nomin
description: The Poss'Nomin were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Illarreen. Thickly built humanoids slightly larger than the average Human, they were easily recognized by their large, shovel-shaped jaws and their three eyes.

data.name: Poss'Nomin
data.skincolor: Red, with black- or brown-spotted forearms in some races
